item.title: Aunty Esther dies after rejecting transfusion amid battle with breast cancer
item.description: Social media user Aunty Esther dies after refusing transfusion for breast cancer due to her faith. Nigerians donated ₦30.7m for her care. Debate erupts online.

item.title: Lady shares moment she wiped off over 20k messages exchanged with boyfriend, shares why
item.description: A Nigerian lady has expressed her pain on social media after her man broke up with her on boxing day. Netizens reacted massively to her viral tweet.

item.title: Read emotional post as lady mourns demise of Aunty Esther
item.description: A young Nigerian lady has shared a heartbreaking post on the X app mourning the alleged demise of a popular personal shopper known as Aunty Esther.

item.description: Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle has spoken after Nigeria reached the Round of 16 of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations with a nervy 3-2 win over Tunisia

item.title: Tinubu carries sacred staff at Eyo festival, see photos
item.description: President Bola Tinubu participates in Lagos’ Eyo 2025 festival, carrying the sacred staff as hundreds celebrate the city’s rich cultural heritage.

item.title: Tension as top senator mentions place US should drop bomb after Sokoto
item.description: Ali Ndume, the senator representing Borno south, has raised a fresh alarm and mentioned the next place the US should drop its missile after the Sokoto bombing.

item.title: Breaking Fresh bomb explodes in another northern state
item.description: There is a fresh tension as powerful explosions rocked another state in the northern part of the country after US operation in Sokoto and Boko Haram attack in Borno.

item.description: President Bola Tinubu along with his wife, Oluremi Tinubu, have visited the resident of an influential billionaire and conferred the top national honour on his.

item.title: 2027 election: Atiku speaks on 'withdrawing' from presidential race
